edit.description: snapshotReverted's two raw git reads route through the sibling module it already imports
the name-only reader carries the snapshot's diff-filter; nameOnlyPaths' doc comment states the quoting fact as measured
the two path spellings, plus the best-effort pin

summary: snapshotReverted re-derives src/git.ts's --name-only decode beside it, so a quoted or space-carrying path silently drops out of the revert snapshot

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: snapshotReverted reads paths through the engine's own name-only reader and content through readFileAtRef; both spellings below land in the snapshot.
tests: snapshotReverted writes a non-ASCII path's content into the revert snapshot
snapshotReverted preserves a path's trailing space instead of trimming it
pins: a snapshotReverted failure leaves the revert path unblocked
notes: Two independent substitutions at one site, both reproduced on git 2.43: the quoted spelling is rejected by the second `git show`, and `.trim()` rewrites a legitimately space-terminated path. The outer catch swallows both, so the snapshot truncates from the first bad path on — declared best-effort, hence the cite is the re-derived decode, not the swallow. Harness siblings are NOT in scope: `harness/windows.ts`'s `git()` already passes `core.quotePath=false`.
